CallParameter.description: Selected JSON or an explicit unknown value with its bounded type name.
CallParameter.title: CallParameter

algorithm.description: Digest algorithm identifier, currently fixed to SHA-256 (sha256).
algorithm.title: Algorithm

value.description: The 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest value, without an algorithm prefix.
value.title: Value

EvidenceLocation.description: JSON pointer to retained evidence, with original notebook location if present.
EvidenceLocation.title: EvidenceLocation

schema_version.description: Version of this successful exposure proposal contract. A plan is not generation, execution, publication or authorization.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

repository_digest.description: Repository evidence identity against which this proposal was assessed; value can pin a subsequent call.

catalog_digest.description: Identity of the complete canonical static Catalog used for this proposal.

graph_digest.description: Identity of the complete canonical static relationship/import Graph used for this proposal.

repository_readiness_digest.description: Identity of the canonical repository readiness assessment used for this proposal.

exposure_policy_digest.description: Identity of the exposure selection and execution constraints used for planning, not operator authority.

interfaces.description: Requested interfaces validated for all selected capabilities; none has been generated, deployed or run by planning.
interfaces.title: Interfaces

capabilities.description: Selected capability proposals with their readiness evidence, interface compatibility and compatible execution modes; not an execution or publication grant.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

observed_support_modules.description: Logical support modules observed in the selected static evidence; these are not additional exposed capabilities.
observed_support_modules.title: Observed Support Modules

external_modules.description: Lexically observed external module names; this does not resolve, install or authorize dependencies.
external_modules.title: External Modules

capability_id.description: Exact canonical ID of this selected capability proposal; dependencies are not implicitly selected.
capability_id.title: Capability Id

module.description: Logical Python module owning the selected capability.
module.title: Module

source_path.description: Repository-relative source path for this static capability evidence, not an authorized filesystem target.
source_path.title: Source Path

repository_readiness.description: Readiness of the selected capability's required repository evidence. CONDITIONAL requires explicit policy allowance and is not READY or proof of successful execution.
repository_readiness.title: Repository Readiness

readiness_reasons.description: Retained reasons supporting the selected-scope readiness assessment, including conditional evidence.
readiness_reasons.title: Readiness Reasons

requested_interfaces.description: Interfaces explicitly requested by the proposal policy for this capability.
requested_interfaces.title: Requested Interfaces

compatible_interfaces.description: Requested interfaces that pass static compatibility checks; every requested interface must be compatible in a successful plan.
compatible_interfaces.title: Compatible Interfaces

compatible_execution_modes.description: Modes satisfying both the proposal's allowed modes/required controls and the readiness policy. No ranking, fallback or execution authority is implied.
compatible_execution_modes.title: Compatible Execution Modes

effects.description: Retained static effect evidence, including unknown effects; not observations from executing the capability.

relationships.description: Retained static relationship and import evidence used by this capability proposal.

FingerprintPolicy.description: One GiB per file by default; hard maximum one TiB; at most 256 files.
FingerprintPolicy.title: FingerprintPolicy

InputResult.description: Candidates or selected observations, never an implicit Experiment Plan.
InputResult.title: InputResult

MetricDiscoveryResult.description: Bounded static occurrences; not an ExperimentRun or runtime metric list.
MetricDiscoveryResult.title: MetricDiscoveryResult

MetricSignal.description: One lexical occurrence, without a value or proof of execution.
MetricSignal.title: MetricSignal

OutputDeclaration.description: Explicit selection or static candidate; never a content observation.
OutputDeclaration.title: OutputDeclaration

OutputDiscoveryResult.description: Every recognized occurrence is retained separately from runtime artifacts.
OutputDiscoveryResult.title: OutputDiscoveryResult

ProviderLimits.description: Declarative ceilings, always at or below core hard bounds.
ProviderLimits.title: ProviderLimits

RandomnessResult.description: Static controls, redacted diagnostics, and versionless import candidates.
RandomnessResult.title: RandomnessResult

repository_digest.description: Complete repository evidence identity; copy value to expected_repository_digest for consistency pinning.

catalog_digest.description: Digest of the complete canonical static Catalog, unchanged by filtering or pagination.

graph_digest.description: Digest of the complete canonical static Graph, unchanged by filtering or pagination.

repository_readiness_digest.description: Digest of the complete canonical repository readiness report, not just the displayed view.

readiness_policy_digest.description: Digest of the readiness assessment policy used for this evidence.

SourceEvidence.description: A source identity is absent when no source bytes have been observed.
SourceEvidence.title: SourceEvidence

StructuredDeclaration.description: Source-bound, statically proven shape or an explicit bounded refusal.
StructuredDeclaration.title: StructuredDeclaration
